featured_reviews.review_text:
I cannot thank Trisha Patel enough for the incredible support and guidance she provided during a very difficult phase of my life. As both an Architect and a Vastu Consultant, she brings a rare combination of practical knowledge and deep insight.

For over six months, I was struggling with ongoing challenges—particularly financial—and despite trying everything, nothing seemed to improve. Honestly, I was quite skeptical about Vastu and wasn’t sure if it could really make a difference. But out of sheer desperation, I decided to consult Trisha.

She reviewed the house drawings and immediately identified areas that needed correction. She was clear in her guidance and mentioned that the effects might take a bit of time. However, to my surprise, within just two weeks of implementing the changes she recommended, I started noticing a real shift—especially in my financial situation.

Trisha’s deep understanding of Vastu and her calm, clear approach gave me a sense of direction and relief. I now genuinely believe that House Vastu can be a powerful tool to align our living spaces with our inner energies. POP vs Gypsum for False Ceiling Design: Which is Better for Indian Homes?

Need a false ceiling for your home but wondering whether to choose POP or Gypsum? Well, that’s a pretty common concern amongst homeowners. Let’s take a look at what Livspace’s best interior designers in Mumbai recommend for Indian homes:

POP (Plaster of Paris) is custom-made on-site, can be crafted to create intricate details and designs, and fits perfectly for decorative lighting. POP offers a premium and luxurious look, making it ideal for bigger homes and villas. Although installing it can be a time-consuming and messy process.

Gypsum, the ready-made boards, on the other hand, offer a hassle-free and quick installation while creating a smooth and seamless finish. It’s ideal for modern homes where minimalism and easy maintenance are priorities. Gypsum is durable, offers fire-resistance benefits, and is also lightweight, making it the best choice for apartments and small homes.

The final answer is - for big homes where customization and a premium look are concerns, opt for POP, and for modern compact homes where quick installation is required, go for Gypsum.

Still concerned about the right false ceiling design in Mumbai? Visit Livspace - Interior Design Studio, Borivali, and talk to the best interior designers in Mumbai will curate the perfect plan for you.

Hinged Wardrobe vs Sliding Door Wardrobe Designs in Mumbai - Which is the Better Choice?

Both wardrobe designs are trendy and equally functional, but offer different benefits. Here’s what Livspace’s best interior designers in Livspace - Interior Design Studio, Borivali advise based on your requirements⬇️

✍🏼Hinged wardrobes are best for storing bulky items such as heavy blankets, large pillows, and suitcases. These items take up a lot of space, so a hinged wardrobe comes in handy, as the door opens outward, offering full visibility.
Whereas sliding door wardrobes are practical for storing outfits, bags, shoes, and other day-to-day essentials. Smaller items ensure the wardrobe door slides smoothly without anything getting stuck in between.

✍🏼 Hinged wardrobes are ideal if the room has ample space to swing open the doors without causing any space restraints.
Sliding wardrobes are perfect for compact rooms, as the doors slide sideways, they do not occupy any extra space in the room.

✍🏼Hinged wardrobes work well for the kids' bedroom, as for a child, opening and closing the doors remains easy and hassle-free. Sliding wardrobes are a good match for households with pets, as they can not easily slip inside and get stuck accidentally.

How to choose the right curtains for your living room in Mumbai?

What’s that one element in interior design and home decor that’s crucial but often gets overlooked? Curtains! The subtle power of the flowy pieces of fabric is an art in itself, especially when it comes to aesthetic living room designs.

If a living room is adjacent to an open balcony, then floor-length sheer curtains with delicate embroidery work p beautifully with another pair of heavy curtains. The sheer fabric filters harsh sunlight during the day, while the heavier one blocks unwanted light at night, offering ample privacy.

For a living room with big windows, opt for sill-length neutral or pastel colored curtains. Add window chimes and ornaments for extra flair.

Curtain rods play a huge role too. It’s best to hang it higher and wider than the window or balcony door frame, as it allows for opening up the space by creating an illusion of a higher ceiling and bigger windows.

How to choose the best modular kitchen layout for a small apartment in Mumbai?

🧑🏼‍🍳For a studio home, a straight kitchen is the best choice - minimalist, functional, and covers a single wall, so the space doesn’t feel cramped.

👨🏼‍🍳A L-shaped kitchen is a popular choice for small apartments, as it utilizes the corner space strategically. This modular kitchen layout is compact, offering plenty of storage while leaving enough space to move around freely.

My previous home designed by them was covered by TOI in their feature - 6 most beautiful homes in Mumbai. My office was a cover page feature in Society Interiors magazine. Have engaged them again for my new house in Worli, Mumbai
